title: Chapter 339 Before The Farewell
content:
Chapter 339 Before The Farewell

Hearing the movement, Shishi and Shishiying was slightly stunned and was immediately surprised.

Someone can appear beside him without even notice.

Time and Star Win slowly turned his head and looked at the person who was talking beside him.

I saw this man dressed simply, looked very honest, and looked at him with a smile on his face.

"Who is your Excellency?"

"I am from the city lord's mansion."

Hearing this, the face of time and space changed slightly.

At this time, An Xing was also seriously looking at the winning time and space in front of him.

The strength is unknown, and it doesn't look like a local.

As soon as the two of them entered the deserted city, he was always paying attention to them.

What he did not expect was that the purpose of the two was just the fruit of immortality on the tree of immortality.

That thing turned out to be so rare outside.

After a moment.

An Xing took the two to a remote place.

"Can you know my city lord?"

An Xing was silent for a moment and asked directly.

Hearing this, Shikongying did not hide it, and nodded, "Yes, it was that lord who saved me and guided me here."

Hearing this, An Xing was slightly stunned and said with a smile on his face, "So that's it."

"Since it was the city lord who asked you to come, then you are my guest in the deserted city."

"Come."

Papa!

An Xing clapped his hands, and the space beside him trembled.

Two members of the Root Organization in black immediately appeared beside An Xing.

"Sir, please give me instructions."

"Take this friend who came from afar to the inner city to get the fruit of immortality."

"Yes, sir."

Immediately, the two walked to the side of the two who were still a little stunned.

"Two friends, please."

"Oh, OK."

It was not until the two of them came to the inner city and hugged a bunch of immortal fruits that the two of them came back to their senses.

Actually, that simple. .

If I had known this, I would have just reported the title of that adult from the beginning.

On the other side, An Xing was thinking carefully about the intention of his city lord.

I think there must be a reason for the city lord to save that person.

And at this moment, he suddenly became slightly stunned, looked towards the direction of the city lord's mansion, and looked very happy.

The next moment, the space trembled and An Xing disappeared directly from the spot.

In the city lord's mansion.

Lu Daosheng looked at everything in the city lord's mansion and nodded slightly.

Everything is in order.

And at this time, the space in front of me trembled.

Several figures appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"I have met the city lord!"

An Xing Awei and Gu Chen appeared in front of Lu Daosheng and said respectfully.

At this moment, the three of them were surprised and confused.

They knew that their city lord ran out to wander again, but why did they come back so soon this time?

It used to be a long time since I went out.

Lu Daosheng looked at the three people in front of him and said directly: "I will leave Huangcheng for a while next, so everything in Huangcheng depends on you."

......

The three of them looked at each other.

It seems that you rely on us when you are here?

Of course, they only dared to say this in their hearts, and nodded on the surface and agreed: "Don't worry, Lord, if we are here in the deserted city, there will be no trouble."

"Well, but just in case."

"null."

Lu Daosheng said softly.

The next moment, the space beside me trembled again.

A man with extremely deep aura appeared directly next to Lu Daosheng.

"So, stay and assist these three people."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Xiaofang said expressionlessly.

Awei and the other two looked at Kong, and their hearts were suddenly filled with storms.

It's him!

Although they only met Kong Yimian at the beginning, they understood.

This guy is very strong and only obeys the order of the city lord, which is extremely mysterious.

Now, the city lord has even handed over this guy to them.

Thinking of this, the three of them gradually became solemn.

Could it be that there is something wrong with Huangcheng?

Finally, Lu Daosheng patted the three of them on the shoulders and left the wasteland city directly.

Looking at the direction where the lord of his city left, the three of them thought.

......

The sea of darkness.

The Nether Sea, once known as the place of chaos, has now become much calmer.

Although there are still places where you wantonly kill, you are much better than before.

The center of the Nether Sea is the place with the richest resources of the Nether Sea and the most concentrated strength of the Nether Sea. It can be said that it is full of big shots.

Even the other side of the starry sky is a little afraid of this place.

Of course, that was once.

Inside a solemn hall.

"God Lord, now the Fire Pavilion and the Eagle Eye Tower have surrendered to us."

"No one dares to object to us in the entire Nether Sea."

God stood in the hall and spoke respectfully.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun nodded slightly.

"The rules I made will be widely spread to the entire Nether Sea as soon as possible."

"Go down."

"Yes, Lord God."

After God left.

Yan Lingyun stood up and walked out of the hall slowly.

The location here is excellent, and you can almost see the entire center of the Nether Sea.

Yan Lingyun just stared blankly into the distance, feeling mixed emotions in her heart.

She never thought that this day would come so quickly.

"Spiritual rhyme."

At this moment, a gentle voice sounded behind Yan Lingyun.

Suddenly, Yan Lingyun's delicate body trembled slightly and she turned around suddenly.

"Daosheng?!"

Looking at Lu Daosheng who suddenly appeared behind him, Yan Lingyun was both surprised and surprised.

"Why are you here?"

After suppressing the joy in his heart, Yan Lingyun returned to her plain expression and said with a smile.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I want to go to a very special place, maybe it will take a little longer."

A special place?

Yan Lingyun's expression moved slightly.

Even Lu Daosheng said that the place was special, and it was definitely not a simple place.

"Is there any danger?"

"Do you want me to accompany you?"

Looking at the worry on Yan Lingyun's face, Lu Daosheng touched his nose and laughed, "There is definitely no danger, you don't have to worry about it."

After hearing Lu Daosheng say this, Yan Lingyun breathed a sigh of relief.

"Come back early."

"Okay, Lingyun, when I have the chance in the future, I will definitely take you to see it."

According to the system, it is still a bit difficult to go back now, after all, even the system will be a little weak.

Not to mention that I want to take someone else.

Moreover, after Lu Daosheng left, it was similar to Lu Daosheng being separated from this world and had no connection anymore.

So Lu Daosheng can't do anything if he wants to leave a clone or anything.

"Okay, I'll wait for you."

Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Daosheng, her eyes full of tenderness.

This is a scene that is simply impossible for outsiders to see.

Her tenderness belongs only to two people.

And on the other side.

Before Lu Daosheng left, he naturally had to look at his daughter.

After all, he is a biological child.

As soon as he entered the fairy world, Lu Daosheng clearly felt that the aura of the fairy world became very strong.

I don't know how much better than before.

You know, how long has it been.

At this time, the Immortal World no longer distinguishes between major sections, but is all unified together and collectively called the Immortal World.

The Golden Immortal Realm, the Wood Immortal Realm, etc., are already the past clouds and mists.

And in the center of the fairy world, there is a statue standing there.

It's exactly the same as Lu Xue.

He held the Emperor Xuanyuan Sword in his hand, his eyes were deep, and his sword was aimed at the sky.
